rewrites.comment: Client-side routing: /chat and /documents are React Router paths, not files. Without this a reload or a shared link 404s, because the static host looks for /chat/index.html and finds nothing.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a changed file gets a new URL and this can be cached indefinitely.
Never cached: it is what points at the fingerprinted bundles, so a stale copy pins users to an old build.
